title: Plasma Orb City
description: A glowing plasma globe with vibrant multicolored electrical tendrils sits on a pedestal in the foreground. Behind it is a dark fantasy cityscape with gothic spires under a full moon in a painted night sky with colorful paint splatters.
prompt: A surreal painting of a large plasma globe in the foreground with bright multicolored electrical tendrils in pink, yellow, cyan and purple bursting from a central glowing orb, set against a dark fantasy city skyline with gothic towers and spires, a large luminous full moon in the purple night sky, expressive colorful paint splatters across the composition, painterly style with visible brushwork and drips.
